parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $32-120x+180x^2$. B1B1B1; coefficients must be simplified; ignore further terms. Special case: $2^5\left(1-\frac34x+\frac{45}{8}x^2+\cdots\right)$ may receive all 3 marks, ISW. Total: 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Identify $x=0.01$ (or $1/100$) as the only value to substitute. B1; condone any method. Clearly use their value in their answer to (a), with $2-\frac32x=1.985$: $32-120(0.01)+180(0.01)^2=32-1.2+0.018$. M1; condone substitution into further terms. $30.8[18]$. A1; correct to at least 3 significant figures and coming from substitution into three or more terms; correct answer without appropriate working gets A0. Total: 3.
